first_limited_express.notes: The 2019 Railway Museum notice states that the first special express operated on 1912-06-15 and identifies its displayed Shinbashi-Shimonoseki timetable as revised on that date. The sources do not establish complete calls, times, train number or calendar.

conservative_verified_zero_service_inter.reason: The last named limited express ended during April 1944 and limited express service returned during September 1949. This half-open interval is wholly inside the absence period at the month precision supported by the sources.

exact_boundary_hypotheses.required_evidence: Original or officially reproduced April 1944 timetable showing the last operating date
Original or officially reproduced September 1949 timetable showing the first operating date

archive_acquisition_targets: Original 1912-06-15 national timetable issue for complete calls, times, train number and calendar
March-April 1944 national timetable issues bracketing abolition
September 1949 national timetable issue containing Heiwa restoration
